notes.s1-2: Minimum is 8 characters — OWASP recommends 12+ for admin accounts. Increase in signup.php and reset-password.php
notes.s1-5: Default admin password Admin@1234 must be changed immediately after importing DB on live server
notes.s1-7: No failed login counter or lockout logic in auth.php. Add rate limiting or account lockout
notes.s1-9: No 2FA/MFA implemented. Acceptable for v1 but recommended for future releases
notes.s1-12: DB credentials in backend/config.php. Move to server environment variables ($DB_PASS = getenv('DB_PASS'))
notes.s1-14: create_reset_token() returns null for unknown emails — response timing may differ vs. known email. Mitigated by always showing same success message
notes.s2-2: PHP default session timeout used. Set session.gc_maxlifetime and a manual idle check in auth-check.php
notes.s2-3: No absolute session timeout enforced. Add timestamp to session on login and force re-login after 8h
notes.s2-4: HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite not set in PHP config. Add to config.php: session_set_cookie_params(['secure'=>true,'httponly'=>true,'samesite'=>'Lax'])
notes.s3-4: rooms.php and dashboard pages use string-interpolated IDs in some dynamic queries (e.g. WHERE residence_id=$resId). Use parameterized queries
notes.s3-5: Using 'root' DB user. Create a limited DB user: GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE ON hilret_trust.* TO 'hilret_app'@'localhost'
notes.s3-7: Single config.php for all environments. Use getenv() or a .env loader so credentials differ per environment
notes.s4-3: No Content-Security-Policy header set on any page. Add via PHP header() or Apache .htaccess
notes.s4-4: No CSP — all inline scripts currently uncontrolled. Plan nonce-based CSP for future release
notes.s4-5: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff set in document.php but not via global Apache header or PHP for all pages
notes.s4-8: No CSP report-uri. Add after implementing CSP to monitor violations
notes.s4-9: No CSP base-uri directive. Add base-uri 'self' when CSP is implemented
notes.s5-1: No CSRF tokens on any dashboard form (status changes, room assignment, etc.). Add synchronizer token pattern
notes.s5-2: AJAX calls (assign-application.php, move-out.php) have no CSRF validation
notes.s5-3: No CSRF implementation at all. Priority fix — all state-changing POST endpoints are vulnerable
notes.s5-4: Session cookie SameSite not explicitly set. Set SameSite=Lax via session_set_cookie_params()
notes.s5-5: submit-application.php (public form) and dashboard AJAX endpoints don't check Origin/Referer
notes.s6-4: Filenames use predictable pattern: {app_id}_doc_{field}_{timestamp}.ext. Switch to unguessable UUIDs
notes.s6-7: Uploaded images (JPG/PNG) are stored as-is without re-encoding. Re-process with GD to strip metadata and payloads
notes.s7-1: Dashboard application-view.php fetches application by ID without verifying it belongs to current admin's scope
notes.s7-6: IDOR not formally tested. Manually test by changing application IDs and room IDs in URLs while logged in as different admins
notes.s7-7: Vertical escalation not tested. Confirm regular users cannot access admin endpoints
notes.s7-8: All admin users have identical permissions. Consider adding 'manager' role with read-only restrictions for future releases
notes.s8-1: HTTPS redirect depends on live server config. Add 301 redirect in .htaccess: RewriteEngine On / RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off / RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L]
notes.s8-2: TLS version restriction is server-level config. Verify on live host via ssllabs.com after deployment
notes.s8-3: Cipher suite selection is server-level. Request cipher hardening from hosting provider
notes.s8-5: HSTS not set. Add: Header always set Strict-Transport-Security 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' in .htaccess
notes.s8-10: database/schema.sql is in the web root. Add to .htaccess: <Files *.sql> Deny from all </Files> or move outside web root
notes.s8-11: password fields have autocomplete=new-password. ID number and sensitive text fields don't have autocomplete=off
notes.s9-1: No CSP. Add via .htaccess Header always set Content-Security-Policy after auditing all script/style sources
notes.s9-2: No X-Frame-Options. Add: Header always set X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN
notes.s9-4: Only set in dashboard/document.php. Add globally: Header always set X-Content-Type-Options nosniff
notes.s9-5: Add: Header always set Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin
notes.s9-6: Add HSTS after HTTPS confirmed working on live server
notes.s9-7: Add: Header always set Permissions-Policy camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()
notes.s9-8: Add: Header always unset X-Powered-By / ServerTokens Prod in Apache config
notes.s9-9: Add: Header always set Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy same-origin
notes.s9-10: Add: Header always set Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy same-site
notes.s10-2: Text fields don't all have maxlength HTML attributes or server-side string length checks. Add strlen() checks
notes.s10-5: Phone number accepts any string — no format validation. Add regex check for SA phone numbers
notes.s10-10: Redirect after login uses hardcoded /dashboard/overview.php — no user-controlled redirect. Low risk
notes.s11-4: Using Apache default 404/403 pages. Create custom ErrorDocument 403, 404, 500 pages in .htaccess
notes.s11-6: X-Powered-By header likely exposed by Apache default config. Set ServerTokens Prod
notes.s11-7: Add Options -Indexes to root .htaccess to prevent directory listing on all directories
notes.s12-1: No rate limiting on login. Add PHP-based IP rate limiting or use hosting-level WAF
notes.s12-2: No account lockout. Add failed_attempts counter and lockout_until fields to users table
notes.s12-3: Password reset (forgot-password.php) has no rate limit — can be abused to spam emails
notes.s12-5: submit-application.php has no rate limit — could be spammed. Add IP-based throttle
notes.s12-6: No CAPTCHA on application form or login. Consider hCaptcha or Cloudflare Turnstile
notes.s12-7: No monitoring. Set up email alerts for repeated failed logins or unusual activity
notes.s13-5: Google Fonts loaded from fonts.googleapis.com without SRI hash. Self-host fonts or add integrity attribute
notes.s14-1: backend/config.php contains DB credentials as constants. Move to getenv() calls: define('DB_PASS', getenv('DB_PASS'))
notes.s14-2: database/schema.sql is inside web root. Should be outside public_html or blocked via .htaccess
notes.s14-3: schema.sql and dev files in deployment. Add .htaccess rules to deny .sql, .md, .json config files
notes.s14-4: No staging environment — dev and prod share same config.php pattern
notes.s14-10: schema.sql, *.md files may be served publicly. Block non-essential file types in .htaccess
notes.s14-12: HTTP TRACE method status unknown. Test with: curl -X TRACE https://yourdomain.com and disable in Apache if enabled
notes.s15-1: last_login timestamp updated on success but no failed login logging. Add a login_attempts table
notes.s15-2: No audit log for admin actions (status changes, room assignments, etc.). Add audit_log table
notes.s15-3: No structured logging anywhere. Add a lightweight log_action() helper writing to a server log file
notes.s15-6: No alerting configured. Set up email alerts or integrate with a monitoring service post-launch
notes.s16-1: submit-application.php is public (intentional — public-facing form). Ensure rate-limiting is added
notes.s16-3: Dashboard responses don't include Cache-Control: no-store. Add to auth-check.php: header('Cache-Control: no-store')
notes.s16-6: No API rate limiting. Add IP-based throttling to backend/*.php endpoints
notes.s18-1: Run OWASP ZAP against staging before go-live
notes.s18-2: Test at securityheaders.com after adding .htaccess security headers
notes.s18-3: Test at ssllabs.com after HTTPS configured on live server — target A rating
notes.s18-4: Search Google for: site:hilrettrust.co.za filetype:sql OR filetype:env after indexing
notes.s18-5: Review all PHP files for TODO/FIXME comments before deployment
notes.s18-7: Add custom ErrorDocument 403 /403.html etc. in root .htaccess
notes.s18-9: Manually test IDOR: login as admin, change application ID in URL to verify access control
notes.s18-11: No git repository — version control not set up. Initialise git and scan history before first push
notes.s18-12: Schedule annual penetration test with a qualified third party
notes.s19-7: CORS not formally tested with evil.com origin — verify after deployment
notes.s21-2: Edge cases not all tested: zero-value rent, overlapping lease dates, applying twice
notes.s21-4: Document upload and application INSERT not atomic — partial failure possible
notes.s21-6: Password reset token deletion happens after successful password update. Confirm no race condition under concurrent requests
notes.s21-7: Test role parameter tampering: POST with role=admin in body to API endpoints
notes.s21-8: Document abuse cases: what if applicant submits multiple applications? What if admin approves a rejected application?
notes.s22-4: No resident data export feature. POPIA gives data subjects the right to access their data
notes.s22-5: No data deletion / right to erasure implemented. Required under POPIA
notes.s22-6: Data retention periods defined in privacy.html but no automated purge scheduled
notes.s22-7: No documented breach notification procedure. Assign a responsible person and document the 72-hour notification process
notes.s22-8: Confirm DPAs with any third-party services used (hosting provider, email provider)
notes.s22-10: POPIA compliance noted in privacy.html. International data transfers (e.g. Google Fonts) not addressed
notes.s24-1: No threat model produced. Document: who are the adversaries (fraudulent applicants, disgruntled ex-residents, external attackers)?
notes.s24-2: Abuse cases not documented alongside features
notes.s24-3: Trust boundaries partially defined — dashboard vs. public site. Formalize in architecture doc
notes.s24-4: Single admin role for all users. Add role-based access control for manager vs. super-admin
notes.s24-5: No formal security design review conducted before implementation
notes.s24-6: Auth checks present but no second layer (e.g. re-authentication for destructive actions like deleting records)
